goal: Create a distinctive events landing with a complete image-led hero and a visual, manageable quick-search slider.

intent_model.literal_request: Make a unique events page like spa with a title and image, and make the first quick-search slider like the homepage with images and back-office control.
intent_model.implied_outcome: The events world should feel like a mature product entry point while Adir can change its visible discovery content without code.

interpretation_rules.operational_meaning: Reuse approved structural behavior and quality, not identical colors or event-inappropriate copy.
interpretation_rules.acceptance_impact: Compare the hero component inventory with spa and the card-slider behavior with homepage on desktop and mobile.

cognitive_flow.current_layer: Understand the events world and start from one relevant visual shortcut or the main search.
cognitive_flow.current_decision: Choose a quick event intent or refine the full event search.
cognitive_flow.next_action: Open the selected event results page.

actors: visitor looking for an event venue

facts.claim: The spa route already has an image-led hero with title, proof points and integrated search.
The homepage already has managed image-led discovery cards and slider controls.
The content studio persists versioned published overlays in D1.

assumptions.claim: Current event catalog images are the approved source for the initial hero and quick-search defaults.
assumptions.validation: Use only images already present in the active event catalog and inspect their rendered crops.

in_scope: event-specific hero with title, description, image composition, proof points and complete search
first event quick-search area as image cards in a horizontal slider
content-studio fields for hero copy, hero images and quick-search label, note, image, destination, visibility and order
versioned draft, review, schedule, publish, archive and history behavior through the existing content-studio model
invariants: event catalog and lower sections remain
existing content-studio permissions and audit/version flow remain

requirements.statement: The events landing presents a unique image-led hero with a complete usable event search.
The first quick-search area uses visual image cards and clear slider controls.
An administrator can edit and version the hero and quick-search presentation and publish it to the public route.
Existing event content, search, SEO and responsive behavior are preserved.

acceptance_checks.action: Inspect the first screen and operate the main search.
acceptance_checks.observable_result: Title, description, event imagery, proof points and complete search are visible without clipping or overlap and search reaches event results.

acceptance_checks.setup: Open the first quick-search section with more items than the visible viewport.
acceptance_checks.action: Use cards, keyboard focus and both arrows.
acceptance_checks.observable_result: Cards open meaningful event URLs, arrows reflect real boundaries semantically and visually, and horizontal use works without page overflow.

acceptance_checks.setup: Authenticate as an allowed VII administrator and select the events landing item.
acceptance_checks.action: Edit presentation fields, save a draft, reload, then publish.
acceptance_checks.observable_result: The draft survives reload without changing public output; publishing creates a version and the same values appear on /events.

acceptance_checks.setup: Submit malformed image or destination data or a stale version.
acceptance_checks.observable_result: The server rejects unsafe data or version conflict and the editor preserves a recoverable state.

acceptance_checks.setup: Open the changed event landing and representative downstream routes.
acceptance_checks.action: Reload, navigate back, resize between mobile and desktop and open existing event sections.
acceptance_checks.observable_result: No event section disappears, no stale overlay remains, and the page has no horizontal overflow or broken navigation.

authorization_boundary: Implementation, test and the previously authorized VII production publication flow are allowed; no unrelated production or supplier mutation is allowed.
